title: Rabbi Yose bar Yirmiyah
author: Aharon Hyman

paragraphs: Hyman cites the end of Shir HaShirim Rabbah chapter 4 and the printed locator פ״דד, Midrash Mishlei chapter 31, and Pesikta de-Rav Kahana chapter 12 at the historical locator קא. [101a]. In Shir HaShirim Rabbah chapter 6, in the section “Who is this,” Rabbi Elazar reports in his name.

notes.text: The locator פ״דד is unresolved and is not silently reduced to chapter 4 or expanded to 4:4.

The saved whole Torat Emet Shir HaShirim Rabbah6:10:1 scalar explicitly has Rabbi Elazar in Rabbi Yose bar Yirmiyah’s name on Who is this; whole1:7:2 independently names Rabbi Yose bar Yirmiyah. These support the titles and final chain, not a mapping of supplied end-of-chapter4 or פ״דד to1:7. Pesikta12:1 was a search snippet only, not a fully inspected witness; קא. remains an edition-dependent historical101a convention. Midrash Mishlei31 and unresolved פ״דד remain supplied, without source clearance.

The consulted Shir HaShirim Rabbah 6:10:1 names Rabbi Elazar as reporting in Rabbi Yose bar Yirmiyah’s name. In Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:7:2, Buber’s Midrash Mishlei chapter 31, and Mandelbaum’s Pesikta de-Rav Kahana 12:1, Rabbi Yose compares the prophets to women who freely ask for what their households need. The reference to the end of chapter 4, the separate printed locator פ״דד, and the pagination of Hyman’s Pesikta edition remain unresolved.
